decisions.base: One 800-card complete Base checklist. First Series #1-700 and High Series #701-800; original High Series packs also contained low numbers.
decisions.rookies: TCDB 107 rookie-source records, with six duplicated error/correction numbers; expected 101 unique Base rookie identities, subject to live validation.
decisions.holograms: 26 separately collectible, unnumbered 2x2 team-logo holograms. Assign stable NNO-01 to NNO-26 in original TCDB checklist order; one hologram per original pack.
decisions.heroes: 10 Baseball Heroes cards (#1-9 plus NNO Header), High Series pack exclusive.
decisions.autograph: One separately collectible Reggie Jackson signed #9 checklist, hand-numbered /2500, High Series pack-issued.
decisions.excluded: Base Set Aftermarket is not an original pack-inserted product family. Printing variants not extra collectibles.
decisions.pack: VCS four-card packs and 24 packs/box; original was 15-card foil packs. High-series-only Heroes and autograph require explicit pack-odds review before release.
decisions.release: Product remains unreleased until card scans, pack odds, pricing and final QA.
